metadata.explanation: Task chains the solved Save As goal with applying Fade transitions to all slides. Evaluator awards 0.5 for pre.pptx existing on Desktop and 0.5 for all slides having a Fade transition applied. Getter extracts the OOXML p:transition child tag name per slide (e.g. 'fade', 'dissolve', 'present'). Metric compares each tag case-insensitively against expected_transition ('fade'); 'present' (transition element with no typed child) is treated as non-fade and fails the check. [Fixed: renamed getter and metric functions to use correct 32-char MD5 hash 5e93f9ddd16cd129b875ad7386e8a5e5; Fixed: metric now compares transition tags against expected_transition instead of only checking t is not None]

fix_history: Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in task JSON to use correct hash

Fix 4: Metric sub-goal 2 now compares transition tags against expected_transition (case-insensitive) instead of only checking t is not None — ensures only 'fade' transitions pass, not arbitrary transition types or 'present' fallback

llm_judge_reasons: The getter correctly retrieves pre.pptx from /home/user/Desktop and parses OOXML to extract the p:transition child tag name per slide.

The getter handles all edge cases: None for slides with no transition element, 'present' for a bare transition element with no typed child, and the actual tag name (e.g., 'fade') for typed transitions.
Sub-goal 1 correctly awards 0.5 when file_exists is True, verifying the file was saved on the Desktop as pre.pptx.

Sub-goal 2 now correctly uses `all(isinstance(t, str) and t.lower() == expected_transition.lower() for t in transitions)`, which only awards 0.5 when every slide has exactly the 'fade' transition type.
The 'present' edge case (transition element with no typed child) is correctly rejected as non-fade.
The expected_transition variable is properly read from expected.get('transition_type', 'fade') and used in the comparison, matching the evaluator config rule {'transition_type': 'fade'}.
The evaluator fully covers both requirements from the instruction: file saved as pre.pptx on Desktop AND all slides having a Fade transition.
